# Check on your JatayuOS machine

1. Disable rotation and close the old app. Install 1.2.1 with APT. Verify APT removes the old India wallpaper package.
2. Launch the app. Verify 24 scenes across three pages, with no old India photos.
3. Apply a scene. Check Fill and Fit on the desktop. Search for Galaxy, mark a favourite and verify it persists after reopening.
4. On two monitors, test each Plasma screen ID, then All screens. Changes affect the current Activity.
5. Enable Every minute rotation, close the app, and verify it continues. Disable it and verify it stops. Log out/in to check startup behaviour.
6. Under your dark Plasma theme, confirm preview labels and controls below Apply Wallpaper are readable. Check a maximised and smaller window.

Report any error with a screenshot and terminal output from `jatayu-wallpaper`. Run the GUI as your normal desktop user.
